svg.title: Reading the sector projectively does not change a block-diagonal state. The source cost is the total Hilbert dimension D = ∑︁ y dim Hy, including its visible current-symbol register. An open Markov channel, with fresh environment degrees of freedom at each step, is allowed explicitly. This parallels the fresh randomness allowed in a classical stochastic Markov source; it is not a count of all environmental or archival degrees of freedom in a closed universe.
